title: Full Body Dumbbell Workout
description: A simple yet effective full body routine designed to train every major muscle group using a pair of dumbbells. Perfect for building muscle and strength efficiently at home.

exercises.title: Lateral Raises
cues: Keep a slight bend in your elbows
Lead with your elbows and raise weights to shoulder height
exercises.why: Targets the lateral deltoids to build shoulder width and definition.

exercises.title: Floor Presses
cues: Keep your lower back pressed flat into the floor
Lower elbows to a 45-degree angle relative to your torso
exercises.why: Develops pressing strength and upper body muscle mass while protecting the shoulders.

exercises.title: Single Arm Overhead Extensions
cues: Keep your upper arm close to your ear and stationary
Lower the dumbbell behind your head for a full stretch
exercises.why: Isolates the triceps for enhanced arm size and pressing power.

exercises.title: Bent Over Rows
cues: Maintain a flat back and hinge at the hips
Pull the dumbbells toward your hips, squeezing your shoulder blades together
exercises.why: Strengthens the entire posterior chain and improves posture.

exercises.title: Dumbbell Curls
cues: Keep your elbows locked by your sides
Supinate your wrists as you lift for maximum contraction
exercises.why: Builds bicep peak and arm hypertrophy.

exercises.title: Forward Lunges
cues: Take a controlled step forward and lower your back knee gently toward the floor
Keep your torso upright and front knee tracking over your toes
exercises.why: Enhances single-leg stability and lower body muscular endurance.

exercises.title: Dumbbell Crunches
cues: Hold the dumbbell securely against your chest
Exhale as you crunch your ribs toward your pelvis, keeping lower back down
exercises.why: Strengthens the abdominal wall and core stability with added resistance.

tips: Choose a dumbbell weight that challenges you on the final 2-3 reps of each set.
Rest for 60-90 seconds between exercises to maintain good form.

title: Fix Bad Posture & Tone Arms Workout
description: A targeted upper body session designed to correct bad posture and tone the arms using bodyweight or light resistance. Perform 3 sets of 10-12 repetitions for optimal strength and toning results.

exercises.title: Posture Correction and Arm Toning Exercises
cues: Keep your core engaged and spine neutral throughout the movement.
Focus on controlled pacing and squeeze the muscles at peak contraction.
exercises.why: Improves alignment, strengthens the upper back to combat slouching, and sculpts the arms.

tips: Prioritize form over speed to effectively target the postural muscles.
Stay consistent and incorporate this routine into your weekly schedule for noticeable improvements.

title: Day 25 Full Body Challenge
description: Short home workout challenge: upper body push, lower body compound squat, posture & shoulder blade retraction with broom handle, and chair step-up progression.

exercises.title: General warm-up
cues: Arm circles, hip circles, leg swings, a few slow bodyweight squats.
Not shown in the video — suggested, adjust as you like.

exercises.title: Push-ups
cues: Hands under shoulders, body in one straight line.
Lower chest to the mat, press back up.

exercises.title: Bodyweight squats
cues: Feet shoulder-width, sit hips back and down, chest up.
Drive through the heels to stand.
exercises.why: targets the lower body directly after the upper-body push.

exercises.title: Prone shoulder raises
cues: Lie prone, wide grip on the stick, arms straight out in front.
Lift the stick and carry it back over your head toward your upper back, then return it to the front. Keep the neck long.
exercises.why: shoulder joint mobility and posture correction.

exercises.title: Elbow pullbacks with chest lift
cues: From the prone raise position, pull the elbows back toward the ribs, drawing the stick to the chest.
Lift the chest slightly as you pull; squeeze the shoulder blades, then extend back out.
exercises.why: engages the upper-back muscles and opens up the chest.

exercises.title: Prone overhead stick raise
cues: Narrow grip, arms straight overhead in line with the body.
Lift the stick a few inches, reaching long; lower with control.
exercises.why: straightens the lower traps and stabilizes the shoulder blades during overhead movements.

exercises.title: Chair step-up progression
cues: Use a stable chair against a wall. Place the whole foot on the seat, not just the toes.
The number of minutes for the "keep going" round isn't legible in the video; fill the time left inside your 30 minutes.
exercises.why: the creator's favourite for the legs — by the last set he could barely stand on them.

exercises.title: Cool-down
cues: Walk it off, then stretch quads, hip flexors and chest.
Not in the video — suggested.

tips: Push-ups: 10 reps clean form, maintain plank alignment.
Prone raises: keep arms straight and engage mid-back.
Step-ups: push through the whole foot on the chair, avoid launching off bottom foot.
